entities.summary: Christopher G. Moore is a Canadian writer living in Thailand, best known for his Land of Smiles Trilogy and his Vincent Calvino Private Eye series. Moore is the author of more than thirty novels, six works of non-fiction, four radio dramas, and editor of three anthologies.
